article.headline: Boston faces Milwaukee, looks for 5th straight home win
article.description: Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (5-2, third in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Boston faces Milwaukee, looks for 5th straight home win
article.linkText: Boston faces Milwaukee, looks for 5th straight home win
article.story: Milwaukee Bucks (1-6, 14th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (5-2, third in the Eastern Conference) Boston; Wednesday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Boston will try to keep its four-game home win streak alive when the Celtics play Milwaukee. Boston went 56-26 overall and 36-16 in Eastern Conference play last season. The Celtics gave up 107.2 points per game while committing 19.0 fouls last season. Milwaukee finished 32-50 overall and 21-31 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Bucks averaged 110.6 points per game last season, 13.9 from the free-throw line and 45.3 from 3-point range. INJURIES: Celtics: Paul George: out (rest), Devin Carter: out (illness). Bucks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
